_meta.description: Musician subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: debuff tempo, buff support, tanky sustain.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la durée des debuffs infligés de 1% et la précision de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff duration inflicted by 1% and accuracy by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la durée des buffs de 1% et la régénération de Souffle de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases buff duration by 1% and Breath regeneration by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la réduction de dégâts de 0.8% et le Souffle max de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage reduction by 0.8% and max Breath by 0.5% per level.
